name: 32250 · Jax Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 32250 (Jax Bch) has 177 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32250 (Jax Bch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32250 (Jax Bch) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
